Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the lineage and incorrectly concluded that the paternal grandfather was Charles Louis Bretagne de La Trémoille (6th Duke), effectively skipping a generation. They assumed the 8th Duke’s father was the 6th Duke instead of the 7th Duke (Charles Armand René), and also relied on an unverified Geni claim that the 8th Duke was “Charles Godefroy,” failing to cross-check with authoritative sources. This synthesis error directly led to the wrong identification of the paternal grandfather.
